title: Rapid Clearing of Thick Human Lung Tissue Sections
author: Cory Poole

steps.title: Prepare 1X PBS solution
steps.instruction: Add 50 mL of 10X Phosphate Buffered Saline to 450 mL ultrapure water, mix well, and store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare 100% CUBIC‑L solution
steps.instruction: In a 50 mL conical tube add 16 g ultrapure water, then 2 g Triton X‑100; swirl until dissolved. In a fume hood add 2 mL N‑butyldiethanolamine, swirl to homogeneity, seal with Parafilm and store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare 50% CUBIC‑L solution
steps.instruction: In a separate 50 mL conical tube combine 5 mL ultrapure water with 5 mL 100 % CUBIC‑L, swirl to mix, seal with Parafilm and store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare 100% CUBIC‑R solution
steps.instruction: In a 50 mL conical tube add 5.0 g ultrapure water, then 6.0 g N‑methylnicotinamide; shake until dissolved. Add 9.0 g Antipyrine, shake until fully dissolved (solution clear to slight yellow). Seal immediately with Parafilm to prevent evaporation and store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare 50% CUBIC‑R solution
steps.instruction: In another 50 mL conical tube mix 5 mL ultrapure water with 5 mL 100 % CUBIC‑R, swirl, seal with Parafilm and store at room temperature.

steps.title: Label tubes and add PBS
steps.instruction: Label each 50 mL conical tube with the section ID and fill with 40 mL 1X PBS (skip if PBS is already 1X).

steps.title: Wash sections in PBS (5 washes)
steps.instruction: Place each tube in a rack on a rotator set to low speed; wash for 15 min, then use a transfer pipette to remove PBS and add fresh PBS. Repeat for a total of five 15‑minute washes, taking care not to damage the sections.

steps.title: Add final PBS before clearing
steps.instruction: After the fifth wash, add another 40 mL PBS and keep the tube on the rotator at low speed while preparing the next step.

steps.title: Transfer to 50% CUBIC‑L
steps.instruction: Remove PBS with a transfer pipette, immediately add 5 mL 50 % CUBIC‑L, gently swirl to ensure the section is free‑floating, and place the tube back in the rack. Repeat for all samples.

steps.title: Incubate in 50% CUBIC‑L
steps.instruction: Place the rack in an incubator (type unspecified) for a minimum of 3 h and a maximum of 6 h; ideally keep on a low‑speed rotator, otherwise gently swirl the sections once or twice during incubation.

steps.title: Remove and dispose 50% CUBIC‑L
steps.instruction: Take the tubes out of the incubator, remove the 50 % CUBIC‑L solution with a transfer pipette without damaging the sections, and discard the solution into a properly labeled waste container.

steps.title: Transfer to 100% CUBIC‑L
steps.instruction: Immediately add 5 mL 100 % CUBIC‑L to each tube, give a gentle swirl and verify the section remains free‑floating.

steps.title: Daily replacement of 100% CUBIC‑L
steps.instruction: Each day, remove the used 100 % CUBIC‑L with a transfer pipette, add fresh 100 % CUBIC‑L, return the samples to the incubator, and place the removed solution into a labeled waste container.

steps.title: Incubate in 100% CUBIC‑L at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Place the samples in a 37 °C incubator for approximately 48 h (time may vary with blood content and section thickness).

steps.title: Remove 100% CUBIC‑L after incubation
steps.instruction: At the end of the incubation, gently remove the 100 % CUBIC‑L solution from each sample.

steps.title: Wash sections in PBS (5 washes)
steps.instruction: Wash the samples with 40 mL PBS on the rotator for 15 min each, performing five washes; after a couple of washes you may move the sections to a new container to aid removal of CUBIC‑L.

steps.title: Final PBS wash and optional storage
steps.instruction: After the fifth wash, replace with fresh 40 mL PBS; sections may be stored overnight in a cold room if needed.

steps.title: Post‑staining transfer to 50% CUBIC‑R
steps.instruction: Following completed immunofluorescent staining and the final wash, remove the last wash buffer with a transfer pipette and add 2 mL 50 % CUBIC‑R per section. Place tubes on a low‑speed rotator for at least 2 h at room temperature in the dark.

steps.title: Transfer to 100% CUBIC‑R overnight
steps.instruction: Remove the 50 % CUBIC‑R and immediately add 2 mL 100 % CUBIC‑R. Keep on a low‑speed rotator overnight (minimum 4 h).

steps.title: Collect used 50% CUBIC‑R for disposal
steps.instruction: Place the used 50 % CUBIC‑R solution into a labeled 50 mL conical tube for any sections accidentally suctioned, then discard the tube in a properly labeled waste container.

steps.title: Prepare mounting grease ring
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL vacuum grease to a 3 mL syringe, attach the small cannula, and dispense a small ring of silicone grease onto a 100 mm plate (or disposable glass slide) slightly larger than the tissue section. Label the plate next to the well.

steps.title: Place tissue section in well
steps.instruction: Using two fine‑tipped forceps, grasp the cleared section by two corners along the same edge, gently place it into the greased well, and smooth it with the forceps.

steps.title: Add 100% CUBIC‑R drops
steps.instruction: Add 1–2 drops of fresh 100 % CUBIC‑R onto the section, work out any air bubbles with the forceps, and act quickly because the solution dries and precipitates rapidly.

steps.title: Cover with glass coverslip
steps.instruction: Place a glass coverslip over the section starting at an angle to avoid bubbles, then press gently to seal the coverslip to the silicone/vacuum grease without leakage. The sample is now ready for imaging.

steps.title: Dispose of used 100% CUBIC‑R
steps.instruction: Use a transfer pipette to move the remaining 100 % CUBIC‑R from the plate into a properly labeled waste container.
